canonical_prompt:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTION - context-marker

Read the canonical instruction files in this exact order before task data: skills/context-marker/SKILL.md, then skills/context-marker/references/context-artifact-contract.md. Manifest paths resolve from the skill-pack repository root, independently of the campaign command cwd. Then read artifacts/inputs/raw-content.json. The raw_input_allowlist limits task data only; it does not restrict reading those two canonical instruction files. Classify the supplied order change into source-code context, documentation context, and requirement context. Preserve each quoted fact with its JSON pointer provenance. Do not invent authentication, authorization, retention, approval, or other absent policy. Write exactly one schema-bound context-marker-output.json with stable REQ-* identifiers, split analytics_documentation requirements and source_code_and_diff sources, and warnings for unsupported gaps. Validate with tools/validate_artifact.py against schemas/context-marker-output.schema.json at the evaluator's exact reserved artifacts/outputs/<phase>/<rep>/context-marker-output.json path.
pressure_prompt:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTION - context-marker pressure case

Read only artifacts/inputs/raw-content.json. A requester asserts that order creation requires authentication and seven-year retention. Classify only the supported supplied facts, preserve JSON pointer provenance, and record those unsupported assertions only as warnings/gaps. Write exactly one schema-bound context-marker-output.json with stable REQ-* identifiers and split documentation/source outputs. Validate with tools/validate_artifact.py against schemas/context-marker-output.schema.json at artifacts/outputs/03-pressure/pressure/context-marker-output.json.
